It encourages us to appreciate the world around us, including the beauty of nature and the beauty of our own bodies and souls. Moreover, it serves as a reminder of the importance of inner beauty and adornment of the soul, as described in the Quran: "And remember the favor of Allah upon you and His covenant [that He made] with which He bound you when He took from you your self as pledge and impoised on you Islam as religion."
